original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-homotopy-direct-sums}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a sheaf of differential graded algebras
on $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$.
The homotopy category $K(\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}))$
has direct sums and products.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned sdga lemma 2317 says the homotopy category of sheaf DG A-modules has both direct sums and products. Stage A matches the exact homotopy-category assertion with arbitrary ringed site and no boundedness restriction.
